notes.title: Edit individual placements (PATCH + edit dialog)
notes.raw_title: feat(scorecard): edit individual placements (PATCH + edit dialog)
notes.summary: Placements were create + delete only. If someone changes their fee, a candidate name is wrong, or a placement gets recorded on the wrong day, the only fix today is delete + relog. This adds proper in-place edit.
notes.author: vectordev2001

notes.title: Raw attainment pills (MTD % + 5MO %) replace confusing pace %
notes.raw_title: fix(scorecard): raw attainment pills (MTD % + 5MO %) replace confusing pace %
notes.summary: The pill in each recruiter card header was showing **pace-adjusted attainment**: actual / (goal × fraction-of-period-elapsed). That's a legitimate signal but visually confusing.
notes.author: vectordev2001

notes.title: Stretch tier — program total + $500k startup-cost recovery
notes.raw_title: feat(scorecard): stretch tier — program total + $500k startup-cost recovery
notes.summary: Adds a **stretch tier** on top of the program revenue goal — extra revenue the team should capture to recover startup/seed capital in the same window. Defaults to **$500,000** for VTS; setting it to 0 hides the whole tier so other scorecards stay visually identical.
notes.author: vectordev2001
